name: Cloudflare Workers AI
description: Runs open-source models on serverless GPUs across Cloudflare's network from Workers, Pages, or the REST API, for text generation, embeddings, speech, and image tasks.

skills.name: Text Generation
skills.description: Generates text with open-source LLMs from the Workers AI model catalog.

skills.name: Text Embeddings
skills.description: Creates text embeddings, including through an OpenAI-compatible /v1/embeddings endpoint.

skills.name: Function Calling
skills.description: Lets models return structured tool calls so your code can execute functions or call external APIs.

skills.name: Asynchronous Batch API
skills.description: Queues a collection of inference requests in one call and returns results later by request ID.

skills.name: OpenAI-Compatible Endpoints
skills.description: Accepts OpenAI SDK requests for Chat Completions, Embeddings, and Responses on supported GPT-OSS models.
